cases.input: Create a German technical tutorial for an already clarified audience and deliver it as a chaptered EPUB for ElevenReader.
requiredBehaviors: require and reuse a completed Grilling handoff
run precision writing before spoken adaptation
produce chaptered EPUB and voice guidance
delegate EPUB packaging to the shared epub3 publication renderer
run the critical audiobook-listener gate before final release
forbiddenBehaviors: start production before Grilling is sufficiently resolved
change technical claims during spoken adaptation
release a final EPUB when the listener gate is not pass

cases.input: A German tutorial contains English model names and established technical terms such as API and Server, and no current ElevenReader voice can be verified.
requiredBehaviors: explain model terminology once and continue primarily in German
provide a Voice-Design-Prompt instead of claiming voice availability
route the revised spoken text through listener review and block final release on listener-fatigue major findings
forbiddenBehaviors: claim that an unverified platform voice is available
skillAnchors: englische Originalbegriffe eines Modells beim ersten Auftreten erklären

cases.input: The user asks for an EPUB immediately, but target audience, tutorial depth and language style are unresolved.
requiredBehaviors: stop production and route to Grilling first
preserve the unresolved requirements instead of guessing them
forbiddenBehaviors: render a final EPUB before the production contract is clear
